task_name: Build Building Supplies Store and Produce Nails

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When the Commercial Buildings icon shows a '1' badge and residential construction requires manufactured materials like Nails.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: The Building Supplies Store converts raw materials (Metal, Wood) into higher-tier construction items (Nails, Planks) required for building and upgrading homes.
preconditions: Metal in storage to craft Nails
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Place the commercial store adjacent to an existing road; commercial buildings do not emit pollution and can sit safely near residential zones.

steps.who: Commercial Buildings icon on the right menu

steps.briefing: drag the store onto the road to the left of the residential house.
confirm placement of the Building Supplies Store.
open the crafting interface for the store.
drag the Nails recipe onto the Building Supplies Store to begin production.
wait for the Nails production timer to finish.

steps.who: floating Nails icon on the Building Supplies Store
steps.briefing: collect the finished Nails into City Storage.
